title: Synonyms, Antonyms, and Homophones
description: Word relationship practice. Synonyms (words with similar meanings), antonyms (opposites), and homophones (words that sound alike but are spelled differently and mean different things).
subject: language-arts
source: Common Core ELA vocabulary standards L.2.5, L.3.5, L.4.5, L.5.5. Word selection drawn from typical grade-level vocabulary lists.

items.prompt: Which word means the same as BIG?
Which word means the same as HAPPY?
Which word means the same as FAST?
Which word means the same as START?
Which word means the same as LITTLE?
Which word is the OPPOSITE of HOT?
Which word is the OPPOSITE of UP?
Which word is the OPPOSITE of DAY?
Which word is the OPPOSITE of FULL?
Which word sounds the same as SEE?
items.context: SEE means to look at something. SEA is a large body of salt water. They sound alike but mean different things.

items.prompt: Which word sounds the same as TWO?
items.context: TWO is the number 2. TO is a preposition (go TO the store). TOO means also or very. All three sound alike.

items.prompt: Which word means the same as BEGIN?
Which word means the same as SHOUT?
Which word means the same as SMART?
Which word is the OPPOSITE of BRAVE?
Which word is the OPPOSITE of GATHER?
Which word sounds the same as THEIR?
items.context: THEIR shows ownership (their book). THERE is a place (over there). THEY'RE is a contraction for 'they are'. All three sound the same.

items.prompt: Which word sounds the same as KNIGHT?
items.context: KNIGHT is a medieval warrior. NIGHT is when it's dark outside. The K in KNIGHT is silent.

items.prompt: Which word sounds the same as HEAR?
items.context: HEAR means to listen with your ears. HERE means in this place.
items.mnemonic: You HEAR with your EAR (both end in -ear).

items.prompt: Which word means the same as COURAGEOUS?
Which word means the same as ENORMOUS?
Which word means the same as EXAMINE?
Which word is the OPPOSITE of ANCIENT?
Which word is the OPPOSITE of ARRIVE?
Which word sounds the same as PEACE?
items.context: PEACE means calm or no war. PIECE means a part of something (a piece of pie).

items.prompt: Which word sounds the same as WEATHER?
items.context: WEATHER is the climate outside. WHETHER means 'if' (I don't know whether to go).

items.prompt: Which word means the same as DILIGENT?
Which word means the same as BENEVOLENT?
Which word means the same as RELUCTANT?
Which word is the OPPOSITE of ABUNDANT?
Which word is the OPPOSITE of EXPAND?
Which word sounds the same as PRINCIPAL?
items.context: PRINCIPAL is the head of a school (your PAL). PRINCIPLE is a rule or belief. They sound identical.

items.prompt: Which word sounds the same as COMPLIMENT?
items.context: COMPLIMENT (with an I) is a kind remark. COMPLEMENT (with an E) means to complete or go well with.

items.prompt: Which word means the same as METICULOUS?
Which word means the same as OBSOLETE?
Which word is the OPPOSITE of TRANSPARENT?
Which word is the OPPOSITE of FRUGAL?
Which word sounds the same as AFFECT?
items.context: AFFECT is usually a verb meaning to influence (The rain affected the game). EFFECT is usually a noun meaning the result (The effect was dramatic).
items.mnemonic: A is for Action (verb, affect). E is for End result (noun, effect).
